title: Reuse literal gate setup: 25.9% less qualification time, full coverage
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Reuse exact P-gate address tables and D-gate phase tables inside one dense literal interpreter during the complete frozen [PR #5818](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5818) qualification. The self-contained normal package passes in **209.93 seconds wall / 209.20 CPU**, versus the fresh PR #5818 baseline's **283.32 / 282.47**, saving **25.91% wall and 25.94% CPU**. The initial unprofiled prototype pair saved 26.61% / 26.57%. These use the same single baseline; they are not two independent pairs, a median or a universal performance claim.

Both literal arithmetic implementations still execute **all 17,651 actual states and 9,037,312 amplitude entries per interpreter**, including zeros, signed Gaussian values, absolute phases and denominators. Every original source/native/caller/invoice/compiler/outer check, adapter/omission control and complete RESULT/CROSS comparison remains active. No state vector, accepted result or sampled subset replaces a check. The original scientific stdout is byte-identical.

Setup tables are computed only with the dense interpreter's own unchanged pure helpers. The second sparse interpreter and quadratic engine share no new setup cache with it. Complete typed immutable width/gate keys, a 512-table LRU bound, source-method SHA256 and four required AST sites bind the replacement. At most 512 integer entries occur per table; key storage is additional. Eviction recomputes, exceptions are not cached and returned state vectors remain fresh.

The inherited single-process source-sharing boundary from PR #5818 remains: this is not a second cold source execution. Five framework assumptions, conditional kappa and selected metadata remain unchanged. 

## Task and overlap

Explicit donor assignment, refined `replay-runtime`, frozen PR #5818 head `a0171b8d2f942cdfc5295307548fe484c570b1ba`, retaining original [PR #5757](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5757) `53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68`. [The bounded claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5818#issuecomment-6432828801) precedes execution. Canonical main was refreshed before work and submission and remains `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8. Bounded targeted PR/body, exact source comments and relevant Discussion checks found no matching follow-up. Exhaustive historical, unpublished and private-work coverage is not claimed.

Profiling came before construction. Whole-circuit tableau reuse was rejected: **17,651 distinct keys, zero repeats, only 7.222 seconds** of setup work. Dense literal work was the measured 117.684-second bottleneck. The scoped alternative reuses exact scalar P/D setup; it does not share oracle answers. The initial candidate records 61,214 hits / 23,983 misses with 512 resident tables.

The isolated package is `research/literal-gate-setup-reuse/`. Its complete official 45-file predecessor export is retained at ancestor `aa49178b0b16cf61ddacfd487226b77baa62d708`; an unmerged predecessor Git object is not a runtime dependency. Frozen source packages and expected scientific receipts are unchanged. The branch also carries Ali Romman's exact test-only [PR #5761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761) repair, source `ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a`, retaining original authorship/cherry-pick credit as PR #5818 already does.

## Validation

Before full construction, exact finite conformance compares the unchanged dense method with the derived method on 1,522 complete states / 22,700 amplitudes, including four width-nine cases. The final suite has 23 boundary/invalidation/capacity/eviction/exception/mutation/source controls, including corrupt P-address and D-absolute-phase detection. All 13 predecessor orchestration controls and seven source-custody controls remain, plus top-level retained-bundle byte corruption rejection before imports. Small suites pass normally and under `-O`.

The full normal package passes in 209.93 seconds; deliberate optimized mode passes in **214.55 seconds**, with the same complete scientific stdout and no stderr, source mutation or resource stop. Kernel peak RSS is 519.03 MiB for the baseline, 521.11 MiB for the prototype and 522.85 MiB for packaged normal. Sampling and kernel peak measurements are reported separately. Shared host load, sequential order and unflushed OS caches limit timing conclusions.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/literal-gate-setup-reuse
```

This runs small controls followed by a **fresh full scientific qualification**, about 3.5 minutes on this Linux host. The README supplies an opt-in fresh baseline/candidate comparison, guarded serially with 600 seconds per command, 900 seconds for the first pair, 1 GiB sampled group RSS, bounded output and no retries; at least 15% wall and CPU savings are mandatory before separately gated optimized qualification. The local development round additionally counts its profiler and all later full qualifications toward a 1,500-second cumulative ceiling.

Publication head is `d2012c1e58cf25825e9a004a80545aefec631886`; all 51 committed package files/bytes/modes, immediate input-pin ancestry and official export/input integrity pass. The implementation export is `e55f42805ce373f9b680a9a2406a035b29e88b15`. The read-only, Git-free implementation export passes under `-I -O -B`, empty PATH and an explicit authenticated import root in **213.97 seconds**, with all **42 exported files unchanged**. All six local scientific commands pass in **1,408.80 seconds total**, including the profiler, within the declared cumulative ceiling. Complete committed-byte/mode and input checks are recorded in VALIDATION.json and the canonical handoff. Later additions contain evidence/reporting only; the qualified runtime closure is unchanged. Full-history preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout; immediate declared input-pin ancestry is checked without claiming a complete history audit. Hosted CI and independent scientific acceptance are separate and will be reported at the exact submitted head.

PROOF.md, PROFILE.json, COVERAGE-GATE.json, BENCHMARK.json, VALIDATION.json and evidence/ retain the proof, rejected nomination, complete output, resource receipts and limitations. Public resource receipts remove only local absolute script paths and retain original local receipt hashes; scientific stdout is unfiltered.

The complete retained archive and NOTICE preserve predecessor attribution. New setup derivation, controls, profiling and Linux measurements: Chris R / Clear1nsight, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents or independent human/proof-kernel acceptance. Memoization/tabulation are standard techniques. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Review the source-bound replacement and its complete-key/independence argument before adopting the opt-in command. Other-host timing remains open. A changed compiler requires fresh source binding, obligation mapping and finite feasibility before any full construction. Profile any remaining bottleneck under a separately authorized task; no automatic successor experiment, kappa construction, worker swarm, monitor or automation is resumed here.
